description.value: Camy's Pizza has been a Langley institution since 1985 and claims to be the original founder of butter chicken pizza. Beyond its signature pies, the menu spans a surprisingly broad range — full Greek and Indian menus including tandoori dishes, calzones, donairs, wings, and fusion items like Butter Chicken Poutine. A touring cyclist will find hearty, made-to-order food with plenty of vegetarian and gluten-free choices available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms Camy's Pizza is an active, open restaurant in Langley, BC, operating since 1985. The about-us page explicitly states 'gluten-free and vegetarian options' are available, and the site prominently features takeout ordering plus third-party delivery (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Skip the Dishes). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging anywhere on the site; those remain null.
concerns: Website lists a second phone number (+1 604-530-8900) not present in OSM.
OSM address omits unit number (#103) and postal code; website address (20759 40 Ave #103, Langley, BC V3A 2H3) is more complete and used here.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant operating since 1985 with a confirmed address and website. Offers takeout and a broad menu well-suited to hungry touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: About-us page states 'They also offer gluten-free and vegetarian options'; menu includes dedicated vegetarian dishes section and veg samosas, paneer dishes, etc
